## Introduction
The data is synthetic glucose biosensor measurements. There are 20 independent electrodes that 10 of them are standart coating
and 10 of them modified coating. Measurements is occured at 5 mmol/L glucose. the aim is to compare current measurements of 2 type coating. 

## Upload the data 
```{r}
electrodes <- read.csv("data/simulated_electrodes.csv")

```
## Examine the data
```{r}
dim(electrodes)
head(electrodes)
str(electrodes)
table(electrodes$coating)
anyNA(electrodes)

```

## Visualization
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data = electrodes, aes(x=coating, y= current_uA)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    height = 0
  ) +
  labs(title="glucose biosensor analysis", 
       x = "coating", 
       y = "currents(uA)"
       ) +
  theme_minimal()

  
  

```
